units.source_text: [2] 莲华寺每年暑伏的丑日举行的将病灾封印在黄瓜上的仪式。

en.t: [2] A ritual held every year at Rengeji Temple on the Day of the Ox during the summer dog days, in which illness and misfortune are sealed inside cucumbers.

units.source_text: 人们从莲华寺请回黄瓜，写上姓名与病况，四日后埋进土里或流放水中，传说将带走病灾。

en.t: People bring cucumbers home from Rengeji Temple, write their names and illnesses on them, and after four days bury them in the ground or set them afloat in water; it is said that this carries away illness and misfortune.
